name: gpu-unlock
license_note: GPL-2.0 text is in licenses/GPL-2.0.txt (no root LICENSE file, so GitHub shows none). The build downloads NVIDIA and CachyOS inputs over HTTPS and generates firmware on your machine; check NVIDIA's terms for your use. Freeweights links to the source and hosts none of it.
install: Add gpu_unlock.targets=all to the kernel command line, then reboot
use: Linux kernel module for GeForce RTX 20, 30 and 40 cards (not RTX 50 / Blackwell, not pro cards). It removes the consumer half-rate cap on FP16, BF16 and TF32 tensor math with FP32 accumulation, so local inference and fine-tuning of Freeweights models run faster. The project reports bit-identical outputs; Ampere is marked stable, Ada and Turing experimental. Laptops lose the unlock when the GPU powers off. Use at your own risk.
description: Kernel module that lifts the GeForce half-rate tensor-core cap for FP16/BF16/TF32 (RTX 20/30/40, Linux).

github.description: Your GeForce runs AI at half speed. This fixes it for 20/30/40 series cards. Up to 2× FP16 / BF16 / TF32 tensor throughput
